content: निरीक्षणम्, -निरीक्षा, -निरीक्षितम् .²1 A look. .²2 Looking at, regarding, seeing, beholding; मधुरैरवशानि लम्भयन्नपि तिर्यञ्चि शमं निरीक्षितैः <ls>Ki. 2. 55</ls>. .²3 Looking out for, searching. .²4 Consideration, regard; निरीक्षया as to, in respect of. .²5 Hope, expectation. .²6 Aspect of planets.
